search.metaDescription: Search words for meanings and examples.
search.placeholder: Type a word, for example: Feierabend
search.note: Type in four languages. It finds translations, meanings, and examples, even with spelling mistakes.
search.noResults: Nothing matched {{query}}. Check the spelling, or try another word.
search.noTranslationYet: No translation yet for this word.
search.phraseWordsNote: No entry for this phrase. Showing meanings and examples for each word.
search.phraseTruncatedNote: Only the first {{lookedUp}} words were searched. The rest was ignored.
search.phraseNoExamples: No recorded sentences contain this exact phrase.

voice.bestEffort: Results vary. You can edit the text before searching.
voice.serverFallbackHint: Record a clip. The server transcribes it.
voice.denied: Microphone denied. Allow it in settings and try again.
voice.failed: Voice failed. Try again or type the word.
voice.serverPrivacy: Your clip is transcribed and never stored, and recording stops after 20 seconds.
voice.serverNoSpeech: No speech detected. Try again, or type your word.
voice.serverFailed: Transcription failed. Try again, or type your word.
voice.serverBusy: Hourly limit reached. Please wait a while, or type your word.
voice.serverBudget: Daily voice limit reached for today. Please type your word.
voice.serverUnavailable: Server transcription is unavailable. Please type your word.
voice.serverAccountRequired: Voice input needs an account. Sign in first, or type your word.
voice.serverTooLong: The recording was too long. Please record a shorter clip.
voice.serverUnsupportedRecording: Your browser cannot record audio. Please type your word.

lists.metaDescription: Words you save for study will collect here.
lists.emptyBody: Lists are saved on this device and work offline.
lists.title: Vocabulary lists
lists.deleteBody: The words in this list will be deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
lists.detailEmptyBody: Add a word from its entry page.
lists.detailNotFound: This list was not found on this device.

review.metaDescription: Review your saved words with flashcards on your device.
review.heading: Review {{name}}
review.flipToAnswer: Tap the card to see the meaning.
review.flipBack: Tap the card to turn it back.
review.stillLearningAnnouncement: {{lemma}} will return later in this session.
review.summaryBody: You reviewed {{total}} cards. You marked {{stillLearning}} to see again.
review.emptyBody: Add a word from its entry page to start reviewing.
review.notFound: This list is not stored on your device.

nudge.title: Daily review
nudge.body: Here are {{count}} saved words from your lists to review today.
nudge.metaDescription: Review a few of your saved words as flashcards on your device, with nothing sent anywhere.
nudge.sessionEmptyBody: These words were deleted from your list, so save new words to start another review.

history.metaDescription: A record of the words you look up.
history.emptyBody: Searches are recorded on this device only. They are never sent to the server.
history.clearBody: This removes every recorded search on this device. This cannot be undone.
history.capNote: Only the 500 most recent searches, and nothing older than 90 days, are kept.

settings.metaDescription: Change the app language and color theme.
settings.appearanceBody: The theme switch in the header works today. Controls for your translation languages will live here once they are built.
settings.languageBody: Choose the language for the buttons and labels in the app. This does not change the languages you translate.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutBody: An account is required to search and keep lists. Use the buttons below to create an account or sign in.
account.signedInBody: Use this sign-in name on other devices. The server holds encrypted data and cannot read it.
account.vaultSizeHint: The server cannot read your data, so it only reports size.
account.devicesBody: These devices access your lists and notes. Each is identified by a short ID.
account.revokeBody: The device must sign in again with the password.
account.exportBody: This local JSON file contains your lists, saved words, notes, and search history.
account.settingsCardBody: Use lists on a second device with an account.
account.createMetaDescription: Use your vocabulary lists on another device.
account.inviteHint: An account requires an invite code. Paste yours here.
account.inviteRejected: Invalid code. It may be mistyped, used, or expired.
account.passwordHint: Choose memorable words. They never leave your device.
account.readyBody: Lose both, and your data is lost. Nobody can reset them.
account.confirmSaved: I saved my sign-in name and code.
account.signOutBody: Lists stay on this device. New edits will not sync.
account.unlockBody: Enter your password to resume syncing lists.

offline.metaDescription: The app is running offline from your device.
offline.title: No internet connection
offline.body: Your device lost its connection, so this page is loading from local storage. Screens you already visited still work. Other screens will load when your connection returns.

unavailable.missing: This entry is not available, but you can search for another word.

entry.metaDescription: Meanings, translations, and example sentences for this word.
entry.pickSense: Select a meaning to see its translations and examples.
entry.noTranslations: No translations for this meaning yet.
entry.notePlaceholder: Add a note about this word
entry.noteHint: Notes stay on this device unless you sync, and the server cannot read them.

enrichment.title: Explanation and extra examples
enrichment.idle: Explanations and extra examples will appear here once this entry is enriched.
enrichment.pending: Writing the explanation and collecting more examples.
enrichment.notConfigured: Detailed notes are unavailable because no language model is connected to this server.
enrichment.stillWorking: This is taking a little longer than usual. You can check back shortly.
enrichment.failed: This explanation could not be generated. Please try again a bit later.
enrichment.generatedBy: Generated by {{model}}, unreviewed by a person.
enrichment.voteSignIn: You need an account to vote, so please sign in.
enrichment.voteImproving: We are improving these notes now.
enrichment.budgetReached: New study notes are unavailable today. You can still read the dictionary entry above.
enrichment.rateLimited: You have requested new notes too many times. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.

attribution.metaDescription: Data sources behind this dictionary, with licences and attribution.
attribution.title: Sources and licences
attribution.intro: This dictionary uses open data. Each source is listed below with its licence and required attribution.
attribution.generatedBody: An AI language model writes the explanations and example sentences marked as generated content. No person reviews this text before publication. No upstream licence applies to them.

sync.offline: Offline. Changes will sync once connected.

addToList.title: Save word to list
addToList.description: This meaning will be saved to your list and stored on this device.
addToList.alreadySaved: This word is already in that list.

landing.heading: Four-language dictionary with flashcards and example sentences
landing.doorsBody: Create an account to search and use lists on any device.
landing.search: Translations, meanings, and credited examples, even with typos.
landing.lists: Save words to lists. Review as flashcards.
landing.privacy: The server cannot read your encrypted lists, history, or notes.
landing.privacyPlaintext: The typed word is sent to the server dictionary.
